Panoramic sunroof and a separate sunroof bring in extra light and make the cabin feel more open for everyone on board.
Leather-trimmed seating, heated seats, and heated/cooled front seats help keep you comfortable in both cold mornings and hot afternoons.
A heated steering wheel adds comfort on chilly drives, while adaptive cruise control helps reduce fatigue on longer trips.
Voice-activated navigation, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto make it easy to follow directions, stream music, and stay connected on the go.
A backup camera, rear park assist, and forward/reverse parking sensors help make tight parking spots and low-speed maneuvers easier.

This truck seats five and includes rear heated seats for added passenger comfort.
Dual-zone automatic climate control lets driver and passenger set their own temperatures.
Power front seats, including a 10-way power driver seat with power lumbar support, help you dial in a comfortable driving position.
The rear 60/40 split-folding, lift-up bench adds flexibility for cargo inside the cabin.
Aluminum running boards make getting in and out easier, and the power tailgate adds convenience when loading up.
Rain-sensing wipers automatically respond to changing weather conditions.
Safety features include lane keep assist, forward collision warning, autonomous emergency braking, reverse brake assist, and a pre-collision system.
With up to 8,200 lbs. of towing capacity, this truck is ready when you need to bring more along.
